taskmap_reference.note: TaskMap no-topo rho=0.75 unfrozen, from Phase 1

shuffled_descriptions.note: Descriptions randomly reassigned across tasks. Performance MATCHES or exceeds TaskMap (47.1), suggesting the mapper does not rely on description semantics for known tasks.

task_id_conditioning.note: Descriptions replaced with random fixed vectors. Still performs well (45.4 vs TaskMap 47.1), confirming mapper largely operates through learned residuals for known tasks.

lora_r40_parameter_matched.note: Shared LoRA at matched parameter budget performs WORSE than r=8 (39.3) and far below TaskMap (47.1). Extra LoRA capacity hurts multi-task training.

summary.descriptions_matter_for_known_tasks: No: shuffled descriptions match TaskMap (48.9 vs 47.1)
summary.descriptions_matter_for_cold_start: Yes: this is where description semantics are essential (r=0 can't use residuals)
summary.residuals_carry_known_task_signal: Yes: task-ID conditioning (45.4) is close to full TaskMap (47.1)
summary.parameter_matched_lora_loses: Yes: LoRA r=40 (37.0) << TaskMap (47.1) at same capacity
